QuestInfo.name: Defeat the Mavericks
QuestInfo.1: Hoya, the boy warrior that you met in 2230: Dangerous Tower lobby, asked you to #rdefeat 30 of each Maverock#k and report to Noi in the upper area of the tower. This sounds interesting.
QuestInfo.2: Hoya, the boy you met at the lobby of the dangerous tower in the year 2230, asked you to eliminate some pesky Mavericks. You did so and reported it to Nalo at the top of the tower. Nalo seemed concerned about Hoya's immature and irresponsible actions.
QuestInfo.0: You ran into #p2082011# in the Year 2230: Dangerous Tower that you reached through #t3994444#.

0.0: Yoohoo! Here! Over here! How did you get in here? This tower could collapse any minute, you know. Since you've come so far, you're probably here to rumble with the Mavericks. Am I right? Then would you do me a favor?

yes.0: Noi doesn't think I'm old enough yet, so he left me to look out for Mavericks below. What a jerk! I can help as much as anyone! Clear out some of the Mavericks while I get ready to impress the socks off everyone, okay? #rJust get rid of 30 of each Maverick type#k, and report to Noi when you're done. Easy, right?

1.0: Who are you? You want something from me?\r\n#b#L0#I did a favor for Hoya, and I'm here to report it.#l\n#k
1.1: Why, that little rascal. I can't believe he dumped his responsibilities on you! I apologize. He doesn't think things through! How could he entrust a stranger with his duties?

yes.0: Thank you for your help. Hoya will get an earful from me later.

npc.0: Smash #r30 Maverick As, 30 Maverick Ss, and 30 Maverick Ds#k and report back to #bNoi#k.
